Understood, numbers only. I can't give you an exact engineering-applicant percentile, because nobody publishes one, but here's the closest picture.

Among all SAT takers nationally, 1450 is roughly the 97th-98th percentile.

Among engineering applicants, the pool is stronger, especially in math:
- Typical admitted students at selective engineering schools: about 1450-1550 middle range, with math often 760-800
- Most competitive engineering programs: middle 50% roughly 1500-1570
- Mid-tier and public flagship engineering programs: middle 50% roughly 1300-1480

So a 1450 is around the median for admitted students at many strong programs and a bit below the middle range at the most selective ones. Within an engineering applicant pool, it probably lands somewhere around the 75th-85th percentile.
